Bst.notes: Boss of the Tower of the Gods (SirenB). NOT a melee walker: a stationary floating head that must be beaten with the Bow and Bombs. Phase A: both hands are alive; shoot each eye twice with arrows (4 arrows total) - each eye has 2 hp and the pair refill after ~120 f of head_hukki. Phase B: once BOTH hands are asleep the head opens its mouth and sweeps the arena with a fire beam (state m2E7C 12). Phase C: throw or shoot a bomb into the open mouth - the head swallows it, it detonates, and the head loses 1 of its 3 hp. Three bombs kill it. Sword/arrow hits on the head cylinder do NOTHING to health; only the swallowed bomb decrements actor->health. attack_range is null because the beam is never distance-gated to start (it only breaks off if Link closes inside 500). attack_frames 95 = 45 f charge + 50 f fire; hit_frame 45 = the first bolt. hover 200 = the fly target's y offset above Link (350 during the eye phase, and the head is pulled to a flat y 400 while beaming and while recovering). knockback and terminal are null - Gohdan has no gravity or knockback code at all (pos_move moves it straight along its aim vector). No function in d_a_bst.cpp is a /* Nonmatching */ stub; the file is fully matched. Death writes the stage boss-dead save field via dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy() in demo state 53 and spawns the warp flower.

Bst_hand.notes: NOT a separate actor - this is actor Bst spawned with param low byte 1 (left hand) or 2 (right hand); it shares g_profile_BST and bst_class with the head and only branches on mBstPartType. Given its own entry here because its stats differ from the head's completely. Each hand has 4 hp and is cut down with the SWORD (its Tg mask rejects the boomerang and the grappling hook). A hand at 0 hp does not die - it goes limp and drifts for 300 frames, then wakes with its 4 hp restored; the fight is only won through the head. Both hands must be asleep at the same time for Gohdan to open its eyes and start the beam phase. Hand attacks are not distance-gated: the head's state machine rolls one at random on a 30-120 frame timer, so attack_range is null. attack_frames 60 / hit_frame 30 describe the fist slam (lh_goo/rh_goo): 30 f of hovering with the fist clenched, then the fall (during which the fingers are the only lethal collider), then 30 f of recovery. Contact damage is Atp 1 from the finger spheres. Right-hand clips are the rh_* mirrors of the lh_* names listed. boss is false here on purpose: a hand reaching 0 hp does NOT write the stage boss-dead save field - only the head's death demo (state 53) calls dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy().

Bdk.notes: Boss of Forsaken Fortress round two (M2tower). Two encounters in one actor. Tower phase (m2B4 == 1, scale 0.85): the bird circles the tower top, Link hammers it once and it drops into the arena below (ACTION_T_DOWN -> falls past y 5500 -> ACTION_START with 20 hp). Arena phase (m2B4 == 0): the mask. Only the Skull Hammer counts - daBdk_c::at_check accepts a head hit ONLY when mResultingAttackType == 9 and the head sphere's world y is under 10000 (i.e. the bird has landed / lowered its head); every other weapon just clangs. Four accepted hammer hits crack the mask off (m8F8 0->4), the first one raising event bit 0x3C01. Each mask hit also RESETS health to 20, so nothing before the mask breaks can chip it. Once the mask is gone the red crest (tosaka, r80 sphere on joint TOSAKA_A3) becomes the target and takes ordinary damage down from 20 hp - that is when the sword works. Attacks: beak peck under 550 (Atp 2, strike on frame 30 of attack1), foot stomp under 450 (Atp 2), and the wing-gust wind attack - 10 spheres of r300 (r600 on the tower) travelling at 100/frame for 25 frames, typed AT_TYPE_WIND with Atp 10. The gust's damage field is left null on purpose: AT_TYPE_WIND is a blow-away, not a heart hit, and asserting '10 damage' would be wrong. notice/lose are null - there is no sight or aggro check in the file at all; the bird is hostile from the moment the fight starts. run is null (it has no ground run, only walk 20 and flight 60 / dive 100). turn_s16 800 is the ground/walk yaw cap; it is 600 while flying and 0x800 = 2048 during the wind attack. hover 500 is the height it climbs above its takeoff point for the gust. terminal and knockback are null - no clamp and no knockback constant exist in the file. No function in d_a_bdk.cpp is a /* Nonmatching */ stub; the file is fully matched. Death writes the stage boss-dead save field via dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy() at camera state 0x72 of the death demo.
